records.description: The function ZZZRebalanceConfirmation.observe(uint256) (src/ZZZRebalanceConfirmation.sol#192-213) reads (side,identity,manual) = this.condition(bucket) (src/ZZZRebalanceConfirmation.sol#193-212) with `this` which adds an extra STATICCALL.
records.rationale: The external self STATICCALL to condition is intentional: observe catches an external-read fault, clears evidence in a successful transaction and emits reset. Replacing it with an internal call would propagate revert and resurrect the old record. No other sender gets observation-write authority.
